_violates: Contains 'transmit_power_dbm', a field the schema does not define. Radio parameters are never in a mission package: they come from a region profile under regions/, because region is an input to configuration generation rather than a constant. A package that could set transmit power could put a node outside its regulatory constraints. See regions/README.md and REGULATORY.md.
